about: Quality trend for the Grant Opportunity Analyser, one entry per fortnightly review cycle. Maintained by the grant-analyzer-health-check skill; seeded from stored eval runs so cycle one has a baseline to move against. Figures are defined in quality.py and judged against launch plan section 9a. Convergence is a diagnostic of retrieval quality, never a target: never propose caching or pinning results to raise it.

proposals_open.summary: Make each cycle's measurements survive the session that took them
proposals_open.solution: GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/quality-snapshot.yml) snapshots /admin/quality.json and /health?deep=1 daily at 07:00 UTC and commits reports/snapshots/quality-YYYY-MM-DD.json. The review reads a committed file: no network, no token, no secret in any prompt. Read path is snapshots.py + eval/read_snapshots.py, covered by tests/test_snapshots.py.
proposals_open.rejected_alternative: Putting the real tokenised admin URL in the scheduled-task file so web_fetch's provenance check would accept it. Thomas rejected it: a secret must never travel through a prompt. That constraint makes any authenticated pull structurally impossible, which is what forced the CI answer. Do not re-propose it.
proposals_open.requires_from_thomas: Add ADMIN_TOKEN as a GitHub repository secret (LAUNCH_SETUP.md §3). Until then the workflow fails daily and emails him.
proposals_open.verification: cycle 3 reports live figures read from reports/snapshots/, with staleness_days <= 2 and no web_fetch or browser involved

proposals_open.solution: The snapshot carries the whole quality payload, benchmark.cycles included, so the cycle decision and its cost land in a committed file every morning.

decision.chosen: option (b) — raise WATCHLIST_CAP to 20 and enforce it
decision.status: APPROVED, NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — do not build until Thomas says go
decision.reasoning: The main shortlist is currently too short to be useful, so information should not be discarded from the watchlist to make the output look tidier. A watchlist can run longer than 10 and still be useful to a reader; the binding problem is the 3-5 item main list, not the length of the tail.
decision.overrides: my recommendation of a cap at 10

proposals_open.implementation_notes: Enforce AFTER all five watchlist entrances, not at any one of them: triage (the only path that currently applies STRONG_FIT_MIN), _enforce_routing_rules, _validate_application_specificity, _rescue_missing_partner_items, and _apply_recommendation_gates. Rank by initial_thematic_fit, which is already backfilled onto watchlist rows at analyzer.py:2857. Consider also _MAX_TRIAGE_SEARCHES (analyzer.py:191), declared and never used — same dead-constant family.

plumbing_built_this_cycle.summary: Replaced the review's live-network read path with committed daily snapshots. Root cause of both blind cycles was the same: the reviewer depended on making a live authenticated network call at the moment of review.
artefacts: .github/workflows/quality-snapshot.yml — daily 07:00 UTC, ADMIN_TOKEN from GitHub Actions secrets, commits reports/snapshots/quality-YYYY-MM-DD.json
snapshots.py — offline read library: health_report, staleness_days, series, movement
eval/read_snapshots.py — CLI; exits non-zero when the newest usable snapshot is missing or >2 days old
tests/test_snapshots.py — 31 tests, weighted toward the not-measuring cases
properties: A failed fetch is still committed with its HTTP status, so an outage is data rather than a gap
Daily commits are the activity that prevents GitHub's 60-day auto-disable of scheduled workflows, so the mechanism cannot be killed by the quiet fortnights it covers
A bad snapshot exits non-zero, so GitHub emails Thomas — the alarm missing from both blind cycles

also_shipped.change: Removed the results email at Thomas's instruction
also_shipped.reason: The landing page promised 'Email me my results when they're ready — you can safely lock your screen'. The app never sent a single message: RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM_EMAIL were never set in Railway and were never listed in LAUNCH_SETUP.md, and the send path returned silently when either was missing. Anyone who left an address and locked their phone got nothing, invisibly.
also_shipped.detail: Address field retained for the grant-deadline digest only, and stored only with that consent. Capacity and waitlist copy now promise a human, not an automated send. email_sender.py left as a tombstone pending git rm (sandbox cannot delete files). NoResultsEmailTest added so the promise cannot return by accident.
